defect: The buy button is below the fold on every phone: at 390x844 the first screen ends at the single pill «צהוב חם» (atcTop 900 in verify.json, atcInFold false); at 360x640 even the PRICE is below the fold (the title is cut at the bottom edge). The BEFORE render (verify-before/pdp-path-m-js-fold.png) had price + button inside the fold at y≈530. A first-time shopper now sees a 360 px square photo + a 100 px thumbnail strip + kicker + a 2-line 30 px title and has to scroll to learn the price and find «הוסיפו להזמנה».
evidence: verify-after/pdp-path-m-js-fold.png (bottom = pill, no price-to-button), pdp-path-s-js-fold.png (bottom = title line 2, no price), verify.json pdp-path-m-js.atcTop=900, pdp-path-s-js.atcTop=863
fix: In the main-product-medias block set "mobile_media_layout" to the dots/slider value (no thumbnail strip on mobile, saves ~100 px) and, if still short, "image_ratio" to a landscape ratio for mobile; target atcInFold=true at 390x844 and price in the fold at 360x640, re-measure with verify.js.

defect: The sort control renders as a lone pill «מומלץ ‹» with a LEFT-pointing chevron — exactly the shape of a «back to recommended» link, sitting right under the four collection pills. Nothing on screen says «מיון» (the label is aria-only); a shopper does not know it is a dropdown, so sorting by price — the one thing a 6 m path shopper wants — is invisible. Cause: the ::after chevron uses border-inline-end + border-block-end rotated 45°, which in RTL becomes left+bottom and points left.
evidence: verify-after/collection-path-m-js-fold.png y≈565-615 and scratch crop coll-sort-3x.png show «מומלץ  <»; source lines 99-104 (options without a visible label) and 146-147 (logical borders).
fix: Line 146-147: use physical borders (border-right + border-bottom, rotate(45deg)) so the chevron points DOWN in RTL too; lines 100-103: prefix every option label with «מיון: » («מיון: מומלץ», «מיון: מחיר מהנמוך לגבוה» …) or add a visible «מיון» text before the select inside .ens-ch__sort.

defect: 7 of the 8 product cards on the path collection show marketplace infographic collages with baked-in Hebrew slogans («עמיד למים IP65», «פאנל סולארי מוגדל», «מוסיפה אווירה לכל שביל וגינה», «האירו את המדרגות בשתי דרכים» — the last cropped mid-word at the card edge, «UMIERE» watermark on another). Only the stainless path light shows a clean photo. A first-time shopper reads this as an AliExpress reseller and cannot compare products by eye; it is the strongest 'stop' on the page and it is what the owner's complaint #3 was about.
evidence: verify-after/collection-path-m-js-full.png rows 1-4 (scratch crop coll-cards-row1-2.png); the same collages repeat on the home «מה שנדלק ראשון» grid (edison «מיד וחזק», firefly 4-up collage with «מראה קסום בגינה» sticker) and on the PDP «עוד לאותו מקום» grid.
fix: SPEC §9 images content task: prepare the sheet (5 products whose clean frame is at images[1..4] → move to position 1; 14 without any clean frame → generate/shoot clean renders), get the owner's approval, then reorder media in Shopify Admin. No theme code change.

defect: Card titles are clamped to 2 lines at 17 px Frank Ruhl, so most Hebrew titles end in an ellipsis before the distinguishing word: «תאורת גחליליות סולארית לגינה – 0...», «מנורת גינה סולארית עוצמתית LED –...», «סט מנורות שביל סולאריות רטרו באור...», «תאורה סולארית עמידה למים לדק...». The dangling «– 0...» reads as a broken price. On the path collection a shopper cannot tell the two «סט מנורות שביל» sets apart without opening each.
fix: Line 16: set --line-clamp-count:3 (and line-height 1.25) so the full title fits in nearly all 27 cases; and (owner-admin) shorten the longest Shopify titles so the product-type word comes first.

defect: The stainless path light has ONE variant, yet the buy box shows a variant picker «צבע אור: צהוב חם» with a single gold pill, plus a sticky-bar select «צהוב חם - 169.90 ₪». A shopper pauses to look for the other colours and wonders whether they must choose something. It is the only 'choice' UI on a product with no choice.
evidence: verify-after/pdp-path-m-js-fold.png y≈745-820; pdp-path-m-nojs-fold.png shows the one-option select.
fix: Shopify Admin → product «מנורת שביל סולארית מנירוסטה» → remove the option «צבע אור» (the variant becomes Default Title and Kalles hides the picker and the sticky select). Alternatively wrap the stock _product-variant-picker in a `_liquid` guard in templates/product.elmsnest.json that renders it only when product.has_only_default_variant is false and some option has > 1 value.

defect: The hero lead says «קטגוריה אחת בלבד» right above a page that offers four collections. A first-time shopper reads 'only one category' and is confused about what the store sells or whether the four tiles below are the same thing. The sentence also runs 3 lines on top of the photo, delaying the button.
fix: Replace the lead with a claim-free line that names the range, e.g. «תאורה סולארית לשביל, לקיר, לגינה ולמרפסת — ואם מוצר לא מתאים למקום שלכם, נגיד את זה לפני שתזמינו.» (same default at sections/elmsnest-v2-hero.liquid line 241); keep the menu order of the four place words.

defect: The hero headline renders at ~60 px (clamp(54px,15.5vw,72px)) and breaks into three lines «כשהשמש / יורדת, / הגינה נדלקת.», splitting the clause mid-sentence; together with the 3-line lead it fills the whole first screen, so nothing of the four collection tiles («איפה צריך אור?») peeks into the fold. The shopper's only visible next step is «לכל המוצרים» → the 27-product grid, not the path tile. SPEC §4 tokens say mobile display 30–34 px.
evidence: verify-after/home-m-js-fold.png (headline y≈490-650, button y≈750-795, tiles start at y≈900 in home-m-js-full.png); home-s-js-fold.png same.
fix: Line 194: .env2-hero__h1{font-size:clamp(34px,10.5vw,44px)} so the two-line sentence stays on two lines and the tiles heading enters the fold; optionally reduce the hero min-height to 88svh.

defect: The PDP's only terms line says «משלוח חינם לנקודת איסוף · אספקה משוערת 8–17 ימי עסקים · ביטול עד 14 יום». A shopper who came from a collection or an ad never saw the home strip, so the home-delivery price (29.90 ₪ on the home «0 ₪» row) is unknown at the moment of adding to cart — the classic 'how much is shipping to my door?' hesitation before the button.
evidence: verify-after/pdp-path-m-js-full.png y≈985-1030 vs home-m-js-full.png terms strip row 1 «עד הבית 29.90 ₪»
fix: Line 24: after «משלוח חינם לנקודת איסוף» add « · עד הבית <bdi dir="ltr">29.90</bdi> ₪» using the licensed coll_terms wording, keeping the line at one sentence.

defect: At 360x640 the header (photo 36svh + h1 + meta + deck + 5 pills + sort) fills the entire first screen; not a single product card is visible in the fold (cards start at y≈600, showing a 40 px sliver). A shopper who tapped the path tile sees a page of labels and a back-looking «מומלץ ‹» pill before any lamp.
fix: Line 118: on (max-width:400px) use min-block-size:calc(26svh + var(--header-height,60px)) and tighten the deck/meta margins so the first card row starts inside the fold.

defect: The «כל מה שכתוב על המוצר» disclosure shows a chevron pointing RIGHT (›). In an RTL page a right-pointing chevron is the 'back' direction, so the row reads like a navigation link, not an expander; the shopper is unsure whether tapping leaves the page.
evidence: verify-after/pdp-path-m-js-full.png y≈1905-1925 «כל מה שכתוב על המוצר  >»
fix: Line 200: draw the closed marker pointing DOWN (border-right + border-bottom, rotate(45deg)) and rotate to up (-135deg) when [open]; keep the existing transition rules.

defect: In every mobile full-page capture the sticky bar (a second variant select «צהוב חם - 169.90 ₪» / «7 מ׳ / 50 נורות / לבן חם - 89.90 ₪» + a second «הוסיפו להזמנה») is painted 130 px above the main form's stepper and button, covering the quantity stepper on the path PDP and the colour pills on the rope PDP — two buy buttons and two variant controls in one screen. The 844 px fold captures do NOT show the bar, so this may be a capture-state artifact of `hdt_show_scrolls_outside_the_scope_of_the_form`; it has to be confirmed on a real scroll.
evidence: verify-after/pdp-path-m-js-full.png y≈845-975 (scratch crop pdp-path-buybox-2x.png), pdp-rope-m-js-full.png y≈845-975 vs main button at y≈1080-1135
fix: Scroll the live preview at 390x844 from the top; if the bar appears while the main «הוסיפו להזמנה» is still on screen, change "hdt_show_sticky_atc" to the option that keys on the BUTTON leaving the viewport (or keep the form option and add `.hdt-sticky-btn-atc{display:none}` while the main form intersects via a 5-line IntersectionObserver in elmsnest-s-pdp-terms-line.liquid). If it does not, note the artifact in verify.js (scroll to top before the full-page capture).

defect: The store's name appears nowhere above the footer: the header is cart · search · a 50 px house-and-heart icon · hamburger. A first-time shopper does not learn they are on «ElmsNest» until the © line at the very bottom, which weakens trust before the first purchase (who am I paying?).
evidence: verify-after/home-m-js-fold.png, collection-path-m-js-fold.png, pdp-path-m-js-fold.png header row; 'ElmsNest' first visible at home-m-js-full.png y≈4330 «ElmsNest © 2026»
fix: Shopify Admin → upload a logo file that carries the wordmark (ElmsNest_Logo_Night with the name) and set it in sections/header-group.json lines 25/50 (`logo`, `logo_mobile`) with logo_width_mb ≈ 120; no other header edit.
